messages.sourceEnglish: Review automatic crop plans from your own growing estimates and saved buyer targets.
messages.text: Hlahloba meralo e iketsang ea lijalo ho tsoa likhakanyong tsa hao tsa temo le lipheo tse bolokiloeng tsa bareki.

messages.sourceEnglish: Check dated nursery tray and surface needs before downloading your review.
messages.text: Hlahloba litlhoko tse nang le matsatsi tsa diterei le tsa bokaholimo tsa setsidifatso sa limela pele u jarolla tlhahlobo ea hao.

messages.sourceEnglish: Save your own growing estimates and review capacity and dates for measured beds.
messages.text: Boloka likhakanyo tsa hao tsa temo mme u hlahlobe bokhoni le matsatsi bakeng sa libethe tsa temo tse lekantsoeng.

messages.sourceEnglish: Review a crop plan from your estimates
messages.text: Hlahloba moralo oa lijalo ho tsoa likhakanyong tsa hao

messages.sourceEnglish: Crop planner → Automatic plan from your estimates
messages.text: Moralo oa lijalo → Moralo o iketsang ho tsoa likhakanyong tsa hao

messages.sourceEnglish: Check your saved design, confirm availability and match buyer targets to your growing estimates. Review the proposed cycles and nursery needs; your saved sowings remain unchanged.
messages.text: Hlahloba moralo oa hao o bolokiloeng, netefatsa boteng mme u bapisanye lipheo tsa bareki le likhakanyo tsa hao tsa temo. Hlahloba mekoloko e sisintsoeng le litlhoko tsa setsidifatso sa limela; ho jala ha hao ho bolokiloeng ho sala ho sa fetohe.
Hlahloba likhakanyo tsa hao tsa temo
Moralo oa lijalo → Likhakanyo tsa hao tsa temo

messages.sourceEnglish: Enter your own assumptions, choose a measured bed and review the calculation. Blank values stay missing; the result is an estimate, not local farming approval.
messages.text: Kenya likhopolo tsa hao, khetha bethe ea temo e lekantsoeng mme u hlahlobe palo. Litekanyetso tse se nang letho li sala li le sieo; sephetho ke khakanyo, eseng tumello ea temo ea lehae.
